g.text: GDHUB-76 phase 5 — who is on the team, and where the project stands

text.tspan: Membership changes
hire · fire · withdraw · accept invite · finish pending invite
currentMembership(user, team | project)
Hired or Founder, not finished; the newest row wins
reconcileCheckpointRooms(project, user)
on the team → in every open checkpoint chat
not on the team → out of them
Every 'is this person on the team' check
project space · project by slug · team list · invite guard
equity · member summary · checkpoint viewer · advisor requests · event common projects
Anything that moves the current stage
author's next · admin edit · admin reset · new project · checkpoint draft
Stages before 'to'
unfinished ones get finished = now
start date left as it is
'to'
finished cleared · start = now if it has none
Stages the project leaves behind going back
(after 'to', up to the old current one)
finished and start both cleared
Stages ahead it never reached
left alone: the author's planned dates stay
one definition of 'on the team': a fired user taken back has a Fired row beside the new one
withdrawing an old application must not throw a current member out of the chats
an applicant or a fired user no longer reads the project by slug
no moved stage keeps a stale 'finished' date; a jump does not invent start dates
one transaction per move, blocked while a checkpoint runs, as today
